text: {"features":[{"name":"Formal education strength","description":"The letter conveys the level of formal academic preparation supporting the candidate's fit for this role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Presents a bachelor's degree in a relevant field as the highest academic credential."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents a bachelor's degree and adds another formal training signal that modestly strengthens technical preparation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a master's degree in a relevant field as the highest academic credential."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a doctoral degree in a relevant field as the highest academic credential."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents advanced graduate study and explicitly connects that training to the systems, security, or AI demands of the role."}]},{"name":"Relevant software experience","description":"The letter shows how much directly relevant professional experience the candidate has in testing, maintaining, and launching production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes only modest qualifying experience, with a small number of years and limited production scope."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows solid early-career production experience but only narrow breadth of systems or launches."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear mid-level experience across several production services with testing, maintenance, and launch responsibility."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial multi-year experience across multiple production services with evidence of sustained responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive, clearly relevant production experience with many years, several services, and durable ownership of launched systems."}]},{"name":"Go backend depth","description":"The letter demonstrates depth of hands-on Go use for the back-end systems central to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only in passing or as one language among many, with no indication of depth or back-end use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States that Go is used regularly or is a primary language, but gives little detail about what is built with it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear production use of Go in services or tooling relevant to the role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Links Go to designing or operating back-end systems, infrastructure, or automation services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a primary vehicle for significant back-end or security-automation design ownership."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"The letter demonstrates depth of Python use for tooling, services, analysis, or agents relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or gives no evidence of actual use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python only briefly or as an occasional secondary language."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for scripts, tooling, or prototypes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production use of Python for services, automation, analysis, or internal tools."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows Python as a major part of the candidate's work, including production-quality automation or agent systems with attention to maintainability or reliability."}]},{"name":"Algorithms depth","description":"The letter conveys mastery of data structures and algorithms through concrete problem-solving examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no real evidence of algorithmic ability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength only in general terms or with very thin support."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one concrete example of using a better data structure or algorithm to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a strong example showing nontrivial algorithmic judgment tied to performance, scalability, or tractability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially strong algorithmic command through sophisticated reformulation of a problem or multiple concrete signals of high-level use."}]},{"name":"AI systems experience","description":"The letter shows relevant experience building or operating AI-backed functionality.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure without clear hands-on work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows hands-on work with AI or LLM features but with limited detail about deployment or reliability."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience with clear examples of shipped functionality."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience plus explicit evaluation, guardrails, or reliability engineering around model behavior."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"The letter shows direct experience assessing systems for security risk.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of security assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals security interest but not actual assessment practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience with threat modeling, reviews, or assessments at a general level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes structured security assessment work with concrete methods such as attack-surface mapping, code review, or fix validation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows repeated, nuanced assessment practice with an attacker-aware or builder-aware perspective and clear follow-through on findings."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation depth","description":"The letter shows experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, deduplication, or related workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of vulnerability-handling automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in automation for security work but gives no past example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions having automated vulnerability or report handling in a general way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes concrete automation steps such as classification, deduplication, prioritization, or routing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows a clearly impactful vulnerability-automation system that materially reduced expert manual workload or improved response at scale."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems depth","description":"The letter shows experience designing agent-based systems relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of agentic systems work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or autonomous tooling only vaguely."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States experience building agentic tooling with some description of components."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a concrete agent architecture, including how agents act and how infrastructure constrains them."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end design ownership of agentic systems with clear attention to safety, boundaries, auditability, or permissions."}]},{"name":"Security collaboration orientation","description":"The letter indicates readiness to work closely with security specialists and other partner teams on shared problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Never mentions working with security specialists or other partner teams."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions teamwork only in generic terms without showing awareness of the security partnership aspect of the role."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States interest in working alongside security engineers or supporting other engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a clear expectation of close partnership by describing security work as shared with specialists or internal customers."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Positions the candidate as someone who actively bridges disciplines, learning from specialists and translating security work into useful engineering systems."}]},{"name":"Mission insight","description":"The letter demonstrates understanding of the team's specific mission of embedding security into development through automation at Google scale.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Describes the job in generic backend or security terms with no role-specific insight."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Echoes job language superficially but without showing a real grasp of the team's leverage."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Identifies one important role element such as secure development, vulnerability response, or automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects multiple important role elements such as developer lifecycle, foundational infrastructure, and automation of manual security work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a nuanced view of the role as platform-scale security engineering that embeds secure defaults and scales scarce expert judgment through tooling."}]},{"name":"Developer empathy","description":"The letter frames security engineering as making the secure path easy and reducing friction for developers.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no awareness of developers as users of security tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses a general desire to help but not specifically to ease developer workflows."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions reducing friction or helping engineers work more effectively."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly frames security as enablement by making secure defaults or workflows easier for product teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes developer empathy a recurring theme and supports it with examples of tooling that removes manual effort or process burden."}]},{"name":"Ownership level","description":"The letter conveys whether the candidate drove work directly rather than merely participating around it.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly lists exposure, familiarity, or participation without clear personal agency."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Uses active language occasionally but leaves ownership of important work ambiguous."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows direct responsibility for some meaningful pieces of work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly presents the candidate as designing, architecting, leading, or operating key systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently shows end-to-end ownership, initiative, and decision-making across multiple relevant examples."}]},{"name":"Impact scale","description":"The letter communicates the magnitude and reach of the candidate's results.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States activities without any clear outcome or effect."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests limited or local impact with little sense of reach."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows credible team-level improvements or efficiency gains."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial leverage, such as returning time to experts, improving high-volume systems, or affecting multiple teams."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially broad or compounding impact, with clear evidence that the work scaled capacity or protected many downstream users."}]},{"name":"Engineering rigor","description":"The letter signals a mindset of correctness, reliability, safety, and disciplined system design.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no clear signal of rigor beyond generic competence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Makes generic claims about quality or standards without concrete support."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions reliability, testing, boundaries, or correctness at least once in a relevant way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly emphasizes dependable systems, careful release practices, auditability, or explicit guardrails."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes rigor a defining theme and backs it with concrete practices such as bounded actions, verification, resilience design, or measured standards."}]},{"name":"Offensive security practice","description":"The letter shows hands-on adversarial learning through certifications, competitions, or similar practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no sign of offensive security practice."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows only a light foundational signal, such as an entry-level security certification."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular hands-on practice, such as ongoing capture-the-flag participation or comparable exercises."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a strong signal, such as OSCP or top-tier competitive capture-the-flag results."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows multiple strong signals or unusually serious hands-on offensive practice that clearly deepens security credibility."}]},{"name":"Open-source involvement","description":"The letter shows contribution to or stewardship of open-source software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of open-source involvement."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional patching or one-off fixes without sustained engagement."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows recurring upstream contributions or maintenance of a small project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows sustained open-source responsibility, such as regular patching, reviews, or release ownership."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows stewardship of a project or framework with real external users or contributors and clear ongoing maintenance responsibilities."}]},{"name":"Personal technical initiative","description":"The letter shows self-directed technical work outside formal job duties that reinforces fit for the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no self-directed technical work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small side project with limited technical depth or relevance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows an ongoing personal project that demonstrates curiosity or discipline."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows an ambitious side project that tackles meaningful systems or infrastructure problems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows a sustained, technically demanding personal build chosen specifically to master hard systems, reliability, or security concepts."}]},{"name":"Role-specific motivation","description":"The letter conveys convincing personal reasons for wanting this exact role rather than any software job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses generic interest in the company or role with little personal connection."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Gives a plausible but broadly applicable reason for interest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives clear reasons that fit this job family, such as security impact or foundational tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Conveys a strong personal pull toward this particular mix of security, automation, and infrastructure work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a distinctive, memorable motivation rooted in prior experience or values that makes the fit feel especially intentional."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"The letter supports claims with concrete examples, mechanisms, or outcomes rather than broad assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on unsupported claims and generic self-description."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Gives only one or two thin examples while most claims remain abstract."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives several relevant examples but with limited detail about what was done or achieved."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives concrete examples with enough detail to show how the work was done or why it mattered."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is consistently evidence-backed throughout, with specific responsibilities, technical mechanisms, and clear consequences."}]},{"name":"Writing organization","description":"The letter presents its case in a clear, well-structured progression that is easy to follow.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Feels disjointed, list-like, or difficult to follow as an argument."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure but rough transitions or an uneven flow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is generally clear and readable, with a sensible sequence of points."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is well organized, with paragraphs that build logically toward fit for the role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally cohesive, with a strong through-line and smooth progression from motivation to evidence to close."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"The letter's spelling, grammar, and proofreading support a polished professional presentation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent mechanical errors that are noticeably distracting."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several clear errors that reduce polish but do not obscure meaning."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Contains occasional errors, though overall meaning remains clear."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is polished with only rare minor slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and fully polished."}]}]}
